description: Expand THEMES to 10 colors with full card background tints, remove image-inside-card functionality, add images as separate canvas objects with connectors, and simplify groups to flat colored rectangles without expand/collapse.
steps: 1. EXPAND THEMES TO 10 COLORS WITH CARD BACKGROUND TINT: In /projects/sandbox/mind-map4/src/App.jsx, replace the existing 4-theme THEMES object (amber, blue, green, purple) with 10 themes. New keys: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, teal, rose, indigo, slate. Each theme should have a `cardBg` field with a pastel CSS color (e.g., '#eff6ff' for blue, '#f0fdf4' for green, '#fdf2f8' for pink, '#fefce8' for yellow, '#faf5ff' for purple, '#fff7ed' for orange, '#f0fdfa' for teal, '#fff1f2' for rose, '#eef2ff' for indigo, '#f8fafc' for slate). The card styling (currently white bg with left border accent at line ~3856: `borderLeft: 4px solid ${theme.border}`) should change to: remove the borderLeft accent, set backgroundColor to theme.cardBg. Each theme also needs: name, port (tailwind dot color class), text (tailwind text class), line (hex for edge color), border (hex), groupBg (tailwind bg class), groupHeader (tailwind bg class), glow, tag, wrapper, header. Update the THEME_COLORS in MiniMap.jsx to match all 10 themes.

2. UPDATE CARD RENDERING - FULL BACKGROUND COLOR: In the canvas node rendering (around line 3855-3870), change the card style from `bg-white` with `borderLeft: 4px solid ${theme.border}` to use `backgroundColor: theme.cardBg` (remove the borderLeft entirely). The card should be a rounded rectangle filled with the pastel color. Keep the white text inputs/content areas as-is but the outer card div gets the tint. Also update the color picker dropdown to show all 10 colors.

3. REMOVE IMAGE-INSIDE-CARD FUNCTIONALITY: (a) Remove `const [pendingImageDrop, setPendingImageDrop]` state (line 302). (b) Remove `const [dragOverNodeId, setDragOverNodeId]` state (line 300). (c) Remove the `processImage` function (lines 2510-2557). (d) Remove `handleImageDrop` function (lines 2561-2568). (e) Remove the image rendering inside cards (the `{node.image && ...}` block around line 3900-3910 in canvas cards). (f) Remove the `onDragOver`, `onDragLeave`, `onDrop` handlers from the card div. (g) Remove the `dragOverNodeId` ring effect from card className. (h) Remove the image section from `renderOutlineCard` (the `{node.image ? ...}` block and the upload label). (i) Remove the `pendingImageDrop &&` modal at the bottom of the component (lines 4424-4453). (j) Remove `image` field from `duplicateNode` function. (k) Remove `ImageIcon` from lucide-react imports if no longer used (check project thumbnail upload still uses it). (l) Remove `image: target.image || null` from clone/duplicate functions.

4. ADD IMAGES AS SEPARATE CANVAS OBJECTS: Add a new data type for canvas image objects. Store them in the workspace as `images: []` array alongside nodes/edges/groups. Each image object: {id, x, y, width, height, src (base64)}. (a) Add `images` to the workspace data structure (in defaultWorkspaces, init code, save/load). (b) When a user drags and drops an image file onto the canvas background (not onto a card), create a new image object at that position. Add onDragOver and onDrop to the main canvas `<main>` element to handle file drops. Compress images to max 1024px dimension and JPEG 0.7 quality before storing. (c) Render image objects on the canvas in the transform layer, after groups but before nodes. They should be absolutely positioned divs showing the image with a subtle border and rounded corners. (d) Make image objects draggable (same pointer-down/move/up pattern as nodes). (e) Add connection ports (left and right dots, same as nodes) so images can be connected with edges. The getConnectionPoint function needs to handle image objects. Store image width default as 280, height as auto/proportional. (f) Add a delete button on hover (X in corner). (g) Add image objects to the MiniMap rendering.

5. SIMPLIFY GROUPS - REMOVE EXPAND/COLLAPSE: (a) Remove the expand/collapse button from the group header (the ChevronDown/ChevronRight toggle button around line 3730). (b) Remove the `group.expanded` check that sets height to 64 when collapsed (line 3663: `height: group.expanded ? displayH : 64`). Groups always show full height. (c) Remove the collapsed state rendering (`{!group.expanded && (...)}` block showing 'X items minimized'). (d) Remove the expand/collapse resize guard in the group header (the button with ChevronDown/ChevronRight). (e) Simplify the group visual: The group should be a simple colored rectangle with rounded corners and a semi-transparent fill (use the theme's groupBg). The header should be minimal: just the group name label at top-left and a 'Create action' button (Plus icon) at top-right. Keep the color picker and delete button but make them appear only on hover. Keep the resize handle at bottom-right. (f) Remove `expanded: true` from defaultWorkspaces group definitions and createGroup. (g) Remove/simplify the `computeLayout` function - since groups no longer collapse, remove the `!group.expanded` branch that sets height to 64. (h) Remove `isGroupHidden`, `shareCollapsedAncestor`, `getCollapsedAncestors` helper functions since groups never collapse. Update `getConnectionPoint` to remove the collapsed-parent logic. (i) Remove the expand/collapse from the outline board view as well. (j) Remove `parentGroupId` nesting logic from group rendering - groups are flat, no sub-groups. Remove the 'Subgroup under...' label, the double-border nested styling, and `isDescendantOf`/`getDescendants` helpers (keep getDescendants if needed for copy/paste but remove nesting visual). Actually, keep parentGroupId in data but remove the visual nesting indicators. The groups render as simple flat rectangles regardless.
acceptance_criteria: THEMES object has exactly 10 color options (blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, teal, rose, indigo, slate)
Cards on canvas have their entire background tinted with the selected color (no left-border accent)
Color picker shows 10 color dots for both cards and groups
No image-inside-card functionality exists (no processImage, no handleImageDrop, no image field in cards)
Dropping an image file onto the canvas background creates a separate image object on the canvas
Image objects have connection ports and can be connected with edges like regular nodes
Image objects are draggable on the canvas
Groups display as simple colored rectangles with no expand/collapse toggle
Groups have a name label and a Plus (create card) button in the header area
npm run build succeeds without errors
